corrections.reason: The printed glyph has the left vertical stem and right arm of 'ከ' (ከመሳም, 'from kissing [my feet]'), which was misread as 'ተ' due to faint ink on the left stem.
The character has the shortened left leg of 4th-order 'ኃ' (ብዙኃ አፍቀረተኒ), matching Luke 7:47.
The 'እ' at the end of L28 is a typesetter catch-letter repeated in full as 'እግዚእ' at the start of L29, so it should not be joined mid-word across the line break.
The glyph at the end of L29 is 6th-order 'ህ' (forming 'አህጉር' across the line break), not 1st-order 'ሀ'.
In Classical Ge'ez (Luke 8:3), the 3rd person feminine plural perfect with object suffix is 'ተልእካሁ' ('who ministered unto him'), and the image shows 4th-order 'ካ' rather than 6th-order 'ክ'.
Preserving exact printed glyphs while noting in remaining_uncertain that the lead type printed የአምዕዎ for ይሰምዕዎ.
Preserving exact printed glyphs while noting the typesetter's 'ወፈረ' for 'ወፅአ/ወፍረ' in remaining_uncertain.
